newsitem.title: ITALY: Saes Getters Q1 net slips but sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Saes Getters Q1 net slips but sales rise.

text.p: Italian electronic components maker Saes Getters said first quarter consolidated turnover rose 10.5 percent to 46.9 billion lire but net profit dipped to 5.5 billion from 6.0 billion in the same 1996 period.
The group, the world leader in the getters sector and which is also listed on Nasdaq, said in a statement that operating profit also fell to 4.57 billion lire from 10.76 billion.

First quarter gross operating margin was 44.8 percent which, although down on the 60.3 percent of the same period last year, was up on the 42.2 percent posted in the last quarter of 1996, the group said. less thslipped pct.

The fall in the margin was partly linked to a different product mix following a rise in gas purification division sales, the group's newest operation division, part of which included high-tech and high-cost products.
The lira's appreciation of the lira against the yen also weighed on margins at the barium and industrial applications division.
The multinational group has around 800 employees with plants in Europe, the U.S. and the Far East. Saes Getters savings shares have been listed on Nasdaq since May 1996.
